1. Objective: Retrieve all IC50 bioactivity records for ALOGLIPTIN (CHEMBL376359) and its salts against Dipeptidyl peptidase 4 (CHEMBL284), including the parent compound and all related salts identified via molecule_hierarchy parent mapping.

2. Output: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.

3. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary.

4. Logic: Identify the parent compound by filtering molecule_dictionary where chembl_id = 'CHEMBL376359'. Retrieve all related salts by joining molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno and joining molecule_dictionary again on molregno = hierarchy.molregno. Include the parent row in the result set. Join compound_structures on molregno to obtain canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on molregno. Join activities on compound_records.record_id. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id to obtain pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi). Join assays on activities.assay_id to obtain assay_description. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid to obtain target details. Filter activities where standard_type = 'IC50' AND standard_units = 'nM' AND target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284'. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Return all rows.
